nodes.name: .openspec.yaml
nodes.summary: OpenSpec metadata for the archived harden-transfer-delivery change, recording its schema version and creation date.

nodes.name: proposal.md
nodes.summary: Proposal for the harden-transfer-delivery change, motivating and describing fixes for three transfer delivery gaps: byte-count-independent completion signalling, prompt offer surfacing with OS notifications, broker WebSocket heartbeats, send-slot TTL, and a single-transfer (send XOR receive) session model with glare tiebreaking.

nodes.name: design.md
nodes.summary: Design document for the harden-transfer-delivery change, recording key decisions such as receiver-authoritative completion, offer emission decoupled from endpoint warm-up, incoming-offer OS notifications, broker heartbeats, and send-slot TTL, along with risks, migration plan, and open questions.

nodes.name: tasks.md
nodes.summary: Implementation task checklist for the harden-transfer-delivery change, broken into eight work streams covering completion signalling, send-slot TTL, offer surfacing, broker heartbeat, single-session enforcement, busy/glare handling, and wiring/generation gates.
